layerDistance.description: The minimal allowed y-distance between layers.

nodeDistance.description: The minimal allowed x-distance between nodes on a layer.

weightBalancing.description: The weight for balancing successors below a node; 0.0 means no balancing.

fixedLayer.description: If set to true, the distance between neighboured layers is always layerDistance; otherwise the distance is adjusted (increased) to improve readability.

useHighLevelOptions.description: Whether high-level options are used or not.

newInitialPlacement.description: Specifies if initial placement of nodes is varied.

qualityVersusSpeed.description: Indicates if the algorithm is tuned either for best quality or best speed.

arrangeCCs.description: If set to true connected components are laid out separately and the resulting layouts are arranged afterwards using the packer module.

nRuns.description: The number of randomized runs performed by the algorithm; the best solution is picked among all the runs. If runs is 0, one deterministic run is performed.

separation.description: Sets the minimum distance between vertices.

cOverhang.description: Sets the minimal distance of incident edges to the corner of a vertex.
